title: Count Pairs That Form a Complete Day I
summary: Given an integer array representing times in hours, count the number of pairs i, j where i < j and the sum of hours[i] and hours[j] is an exact multiple of 24 hours.
statement: Given an integer array representing times in hours, count the number of pairs i, j where i < j and the sum of hours[i] and hours[j] is an exact multiple of 24 hours.
constraints: A pair forms complete days when hours[i]+hours[j] is divisible by 24.
Return the number of qualifying pairs.
hints: Only each duration’s remainder modulo 24 matters.
Before storing a remainder r, count earlier values with remainder -r modulo 24.
Then increment the current remainder count.
Each earlier-later qualifying pair is counted exactly when its later endpoint is processed.
editorial: Each earlier-later qualifying pair is counted exactly when its later endpoint is processed.

tests.explanation: The two twelves pair, and the two multiples of 24 pair, giving two.
The three multiples of 24 form three index pairs.
